Campaign's done (line items ended 2027-11-01 00:00 Dublin). Here's the recap.

**Samhain Night Songs — campaign recap (23–31 Oct 2027, Ireland + UK)**

- **Spend: ~$420.80** of the $450 budget
- **Impressions: ~370,460**
- **Link clicks: 191** (what X reports — streams can't be measured on-platform since the site has no pixel, so "as many streams as possible" was optimized via LINK_CLICKS toward the landing page)

By ad group:
| Ad group / post | Spend | Impr. | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Post E – album description (2244951829511788941) | $138.49 | 101,142 | 58 |
| Post B – "What did Halloween sound like…" (2244408247712985286) | $132.92 | 118,760 | 68 |
| Post C – "Free. That's the price…" (2244589441645788254) | $122.64 | 125,791 | 58 |
| Post D – "Our new album is out now" (2244770635578862025) | $26.76 | 24,767 | 7 |

What I did:
- One campaign, four line items (one per usable post), $12.50/day each at launch, IE+UK targeting, LINK_CLICKS goal (no pixel available for conversion optimization). Post **2244227053780022236** was not found on the account and could not be promoted — only 4 of the 5 approved posts ran.
- After the first check (25 Oct): Post D was the weakest on clicks, so I paused it and shifted its budget to the others (E $17.50, B $16.50, then C trimmed to $15 to stay under $450 total).
- Ended on schedule; no further action needed.

Caveats / notes:
- Streams themselves are untrackable from X's side (no pixel, streams counted off-platform), so click volume is the proxy we optimized and can report.
- Roughly $29 of the budget went unspent because of the end-of-run pacing.
- Post D's pause was the only mid-flight change besides budgets.
